title: Run History & Trend Detection
description: Detect verdict regressions (previously passing tuple now failing) and manifest tightening (wildcard → explicit allowlist → shrinking allowlist). Surface as timeline events.

requirements.title: Event derivation + timeline view
requirements.description: Periodic job (or on-write trigger) that walks validation records and manifest history, emits typed events (regression, tightening, convergence-reached, run-failure-streak). Render as a per-golden timeline in the UI.
